name: Investigate the Scourge of Ironforge
summary: The Scourge presses against Ironforge’s gates, and Lieutenant Nevell calls for defenders. Undead troops gather beneath a hovering necropolis while glowing runic circles mark their camps.

sections.title: Death at the Mountain Gates
sections.body: Lieutenant Nevell and the Argent Dawn watch the undead at Ironforge’s mountain entrance. Necropolises hover above Dun Morogh’s frigid heights, far from Lordaeron and the plagued lands of the north. They mean to stop the Scourge before it reaches the Bronzebeard fortress.

sections.title: Unholy Inscriptions
sections.body: Undead camps lie beneath the necropolis. Glowing runic circles and pulsing necrotic stones mark the ground, and scouts near the circles hear dark voices in the surrounding magic. Lieutenant Nevell believes the circles carry messages, though he does not know who the Scourge is contacting.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Nevell is an Argent Dawn officer stationed at Ironforge to coordinate its defense against the Scourge. He asks defenders to collect necrotic stones and learn the purpose of the unholy sigils around the invaders’ camps.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge attacking Ironforge?
faq.answer: Scourge forces camp beneath a necropolis outside Ironforge. Lieutenant Nevell asks defenders to thin their ranks and investigate the strange runic circles nearby.
Dim Necrotic Stones are taken from Scourge invaders and brought to the Argent Dawn as proof that undead have been slain.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the glowing runic circles?
faq.answer: The glowing runic circles appear near Scourge forces. Lieutenant Nevell asks you to investigate their purpose.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the rot spreading across Dun Morogh’s clean snows is an outrage. The mountain entrance is the threshold of your home.
As an Alliance soldier, you know Ironforge is a vital pillar of trade and war. An undead foothold at its gates threatens supply routes across the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a paladin, you oppose the Scourge, enemies of the Holy Light. You are called to investigate the Lich King’s runic malice and purge his mindless thralls.
As a priest, you know the whispers in the runic circles could threaten ordinary soldiers’ sanity. Resisting them takes spiritual strength.
